About the Project

The Future Fluid Dynamics CDT supports doctoral research into fluid behaviour and its applications. This is a cohort-based training programme at Leeds, with research projects selected through the CDT's admission and funding process.

Research Areas

  • Fluid dynamics
  • Mathematics
  • Engineering

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference rate)

CriterionRequirement

ComponentDetails

LocationUnited Kingdom

About the University of Leeds

Leeds offers research degrees through its schools, institutes and doctoral training programmes. Its funding routes include subject-specific studentships, university scholarships and awards with particular nationality or widening participation criteria.
